lines: We call on all parties to show restraint!
Can we all just sit down?
Let's form a working group about this.
leader.name: Dr Hilde Concern

lines: Nobody told me there'd be punching.
Can I hand you a leaflet?

entrance: The UN Peacekeeping Mission has entered the chamber, waving leaflets. Dr Hilde Concern is concerned.
Sky-blue helmets in the hall! The UN is here to keep the peace. The peace has not been informed.
posts: Visited the {arena} today to call for calm. We were thrown into the buffet. We remain deeply concerned. #Peace #Dialogue
Productive mission to the {arena}. Leaflets distributed: 400. Leaflets read: 0. Bruises: several. #Peacekeeping
comments: I lost my helmet in the canapés.
They took the leaflets. Then they hit us with the leaflets.
exits: We call on all parties to show restraint. Goodbye!
This mission is concluded. Nothing has changed. As planned.
We'll be issuing a statement. From outside.

lines: We stand ready to stand ready.
Our values are very high up. Like me.
I am observing from a position of strength.
Let me be absolutely clear: no.
leader.name: Sir Rupert Highground

lines: Sir, the members are all on the floor!
Shall I draft a statement, sir?
Sir, the horse is eating the canapés.

entrance: Hooves on the carpet! The Alliance rides in on its Moral High Horse, now that every member is safely face-down.
NATO has arrived on a very tall horse, to express solidarity from a great height.
posts: Proud to have ridden through the {arena} today and upheld our values from a safe height. 🐴 #Solidarity
Strong message delivered at the {arena}. Mostly to the horse. #Values #Unity
comments: Sir, the horse would like a word.
Statement drafted. It says 'We stand ready.'
exits: We stand ready to stand ready. Elsewhere.
Not our jurisdiction. Actually it is. Anyway, goodbye!
Onwards, horse! To the high ground!

lines: I have a warrant. It is very long.
The court will now hear the case of... ow.
leader.name: Judge Augustin Proceedings

entrance: Whistles! The Court has arrived with two gendarmes and a warrant for everyone. Everyone is unimpressed.
The ICC bursts in, kepis first. Judge Proceedings has a warrant. The delegates have chairs.
posts: Arrests made today at the {arena}: 0. Gendarmes hospitalised: 2. Proceedings continue. #Justice
Visited the {arena} with a warrant. Was handed a chair. Proceedings adjourned. #Law
comments: They confiscated my whistle. Then my kepi.
I arrested a buffet table. It was the only one that stood still.
exits: The court is adjourned! Indefinitely!
We will be back. With a longer warrant.

lines: Move fast and break things. Like your jaw.
Have you accepted the new terms?
This summit is now a platform.
leader.name: Chase Founderson

entrance: Big Tech has entered the chamber, handing out free phones and collecting everybody's energy. Terms apply.
A hoodie and two growth hackers burst in: Big Tech wants to 'connect' the delegates. And their data.
posts: Humbled to have connected 10 delegates at the {arena} today. Their energy is now ours. 🙏 #Community
Shipped a new feature at the {arena}: chaos. Engagement is up 400%. #Growth
comments: Dana harvested a whole delegation. They didn't notice.
The free phones were a huge success. Nobody looked up for an hour.
exits: Thanks for your data! Byeee.
We're pivoting. Out of the door.
Moving fast. Away from here.

lines: Energy for everyone! At a price.
Don't mind the spill, it's basically water.
leader.name: Rex Barrelton

lines: Where d'you want the barrel, boss?

entrance: Big Oil rolls in with a barrel and a smile: Rex Barrelton is here to 'help with the energy situation'.
A spotless hard hat enters the chamber, followed by two roughnecks and a puddle. It's Big Oil.
posts: Proud sponsors of today's fire at the {arena}. 🔥 #Energy #Partnership
Delivered record energy to the {arena} today. Also some oil. On the floor. #Growth
comments: We left the canisters by the buffet. For safety.
Boss says the spill is a feature.
exits: We'll help with the clean-up. For a fee.
Don't worry, we'll send a sustainability report.
That's a wrap. Mind the puddle!

lines: Please maintain a safe punching distance.
leader.name: Dr Ingrid Swab

lines: Please stand still, you're being sanitised.
Hands where I can see them. And clean.

entrance: The Health Authority bursts in with clipboards and foam: Dr Ingrid Swab has seen the state of this floor.
Hazmat suits in the Summit Hall! Somebody reported a lack of handwashing.
posts: Inspected the {arena} today. Hygiene rating: 1 star. Sanitiser deployed: all of it. #WashYourHands
Proud to have foamed every delegate at the {arena}. Twice. #PublicHealth
comments: We ran out of foam. We used the coffee.
Somebody licked the gavel. We have questions.
exits: Please maintain a safe punching distance.
The floor is now spotless. Please don't touch it.
Remember: twenty seconds. With soap. Goodbye!

lines: Looks like you need a loan.
Structural adjustment. Mostly to your face.
leader.name: Cornelius Interest

entrance: The Lenders arrive with a briefcase full of cash and a smile full of small print: someone on this floor needs a loan.
Pinstripes in the chamber! Cornelius Interest has spotted a delegate in difficulty. And an opportunity.
posts: Pleased to support a struggling delegate at the {arena} today with a generous loan. Repayment starts now. #Development
Today at the {arena} we restructured a delegation. Mostly their jaw. #Stability
comments: Clause forty did a lot of work today.
They paid back with interest. Mostly bruises.
exits: Structural adjustment complete.
We'll be in touch. About the interest.
Pleasure doing business. Mostly ours.

lines: What a derby! What a commercial opportunity!
A trophy for you! The invoice for you.
The beautiful game. The beautiful margins.
Congratulations to the winner. Whoever that is.
leader.name: Lord Gideon Goldbutton

lines: I was a legend once. Ask anyone.

entrance: The Federation has entered the derby: Lord Gideon Goldbutton has a trophy, two ambassadors and an invoice.
Gold buttons in the chamber! The Federation wants a photo with the derby. And a commission.
posts: Proud to hand out a trophy at the {arena} derby today. The commission was the real winner. 🏆 #ForTheGame
Another historic derby at the {arena}! Broadcast rights available. #Football
comments: I got a selfie with every delegate. Most were mid-punch.
The trophy is on loan. We'll want it back.
exits: Congratulations to the winner. Invoice to follow.
The Federation thanks you for your passion. And your fees.
Leaving before anybody asks questions.

lines: Please accept the cookies. There are no cookies.
Punches must not exceed the standard size.
I have a directive for this.
leader.name: Annette Directive

lines: That punch was eleven millimetres too long.

entrance: Brussels has entered the chamber with rulebooks and a measuring tape: too many EU members are brawling without a framework.
The regulators are here! Every delegate on the floor must now accept the terms and conditions.
posts: Successfully harmonised the {arena} today. All punches are now the same size. #Regulation
The {arena} is now fully compliant. This page uses no cookies. We checked. #Brussels
comments: Klaus measured every punch. Most were non-standard.
We issued 400 forms. 3 came back. 0 in the right language.
exits: This brawl is now fully compliant.
Please allow six to eight years for a response.
Directive issued. Goodbye, in all 24 languages.

lines: I'm going to have to downgrade you.
Under review. Everything is under review.
leader.name: Grey Outlook

lines: We stand by our rating. From over here.

entrance: A grey man with a giant rubber stamp slips into the chamber: the Raters have noticed someone is doing too well.
The Raters are here! The most popular delegate on the floor is under review.
posts: Visited the {arena} today and downgraded the favourite. Outlook: negative. #Ratings
Our analysts at the {arena} confirm: everyone is overvalued. #Markets
comments: The favourite hit back. We have downgraded our own outlook.
We stood very far away and rated from there.
exits: Outlook: negative.
Rating withdrawn. So are we.
We'll publish our findings. From a safe distance.
